text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Day of the Spring Fan Thanksgiving—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: It's definitely gonna go great.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Right.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
After all, with everyone's help, we 
finished prep in time.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. 
So what we gotta do is—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Just one thing!

text_block_list.name: MC Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The White Team wins the Selected Ultra 
Tug-of-War! That concludes all events! 
Please wait a little while longer for the 
'Dreamy Night Parade'~!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I told you! Stop worrying...! 
You ended up getting super good at it in 
the end, you got this, you got this!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, I've arranged colors across the 
eight directions to align the flow of qi! 
If you center your feelings inside here, 
you'll definitely be fine!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(There are still some girls who haven't 
shaken off their nerves. 
Is there any other way I can help calm 
them down—)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Everyone, eyes on me!☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Feeling nervous? Of course you are~ 
It just proves how hard you've worked and 
prepared for this♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If you just can't shake off the nerves...? 
Watch Falco's back and follow my lead♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All of your nervousness... 
Falco, right at the very front, will take 
it all on for you!☆

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ehh? Isn't it totally unfair that only the 
Leader gets the spotlight?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? 
After Falco went out of her way to be 
thoughtful~?!

text_block_list.name: Timid-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as expected of someone with so much 
stage experience. 
Still... I can't let myself be outdone 
either!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Social media is overflowing with excited 
comments, too. 
Everyone must be on the edge of their 
seats waiting for the parade to begin.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Nfufu. Well then, we oughta put in one 
last push toward our good ending too, eh~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
After all, this is our first time running 
the tool at full capacity in a live 
environment. 
What we'll get to see is... part of the 
surprise, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I believe it will go wonderfully. 
After all, Tran-san worked so very hard on 
it♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha. Straightforward compliments are 
something I just can't get used to~

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Since it's a 'good ending,' 
wouldn't it be fine to ask for even more 
of a reward?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
In that case... let's see it, shall we~? 
The ultimate thrill... brought by the 
light that connects people's hearts...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's go! 
To deliver a dreamily happy night!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Connecting every single person... 
The Dreamy Night Parade... starts now!☆

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the penlight color switches and the 
illumination 
are actually synchronized...!

text_block_list.name: Online Participant
text_block_list.text:
The illumination notes match the music... 
There! 
Whoa! The illuminations are...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
The lights are... spreading out... 
Ha-ha... Incredible, this is so 
incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All of this is... the feelings of everyone 
watching the parade...! 
Their heartfelt wishes...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Mom's gotta be seeing this light somewhere 
out there too... Heheh!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Giving back to all these wonderful 
feelings 
is the best way Falco and the gang can say 
thank you☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! 
Let's give it everything we've got till 
the very end☆

text_block_list.name: MC Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And that concludes the "Dreamy Night 
Parade"! 
A big thank-you to all our parade 
performers!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Ha, haha...! 
We... we actually did it, right?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. 
It was the ab-so-lute best! Just like a 
dream!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heh! 
No way in hell... I'd let a sight like 
this be just a dream...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: MC Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
With this, all performances have 
concluded. 
Students, please gather for the closing 
ceremony—

text_block_list.name: Espoir's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"You were so cool out there, Espo. 
And so fun, too. I got a great look at you 
shining bright."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
N-No big deal, forget about me. 
Today was just for you, Mom—

text_block_list.name: Espoir's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Thank you... for keeping your promise."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...! 
...Heheh... Well, of course I did!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The world doesn't always go your way, 
but... 
things like this ain't so bad. Once in a 
while, at least.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Don't say "once in a while," stay over on 
this side for good! 
I mean... it's just overflowing with this 
much happiness!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm... so glad I participated... Truly...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I guess running into Buena in the 
hallway back then was a blessing in 
disguise☆

text_block_list.name: Espoir's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"You know, you kept two promises for me 
all at once today. 
It makes me so, so happy."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? 
Two...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"When you entered Tracen Academy, 
remember? 
I said, 'Make wonderful friends and create 
memories that'll last a lifetime.'"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
W-Wonderful friends... It's not like we're 
really like—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Nah. 
Well, I guess... memories that'll last a 
lifetime... that part might be true!
